gloss: skipping school or work; playing hooky

definitions.gloss: skipping school or work; playing hooky
definitions.explanation: Staying away from school or work without a real reason, often by pretending to be ill. From ずる (cheating) and {休|やす}み (absence).

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ずる{休|やす}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
ずる{休|やす}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれて→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I got caught playing hooky and got told off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{仮病|けびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ずる{休|やす}み⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: As a child, I once faked being sick to skip school.

notes:
Informal; a child's or a self-mocking word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ずる{休|やす}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to skip school
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ずる{休|やす}み⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to skip work
- ずる{休|やす}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: to be found out skipping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サボる: to skip or slack off; also covers idling at one's desk, not only staying away
- {仮病|けびょう}: a feigned illness, the usual excuse
